# Pew Research Center

> A nonpartisan research organization providing data-driven insights on American public opinion, demographics, and social trends across politics, economics, science, and culture.

Pew Research Center conducts extensive polling and demographic research to understand American attitudes and behaviors. The organization publishes findings across major topic areas and maintains active engagement through newsletters, social media, and press outreach.

## Key Topics

- public opinion polling
- demographic research
- politics and policy
- economy and work
- race and ethnicity
- generations and aging
- gender and LGBTQ
- family and relationships
- science and public attitudes
- social trends
- U.S. Census data
- research methodology
- social media engagement
- newsletters and subscriptions
- immigration

## Research Topics

- [Politics & Policy](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/politics-policy): Research and polling data on politics, policy, and public opinion
- [Economy & Work](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/economy-work): Economic research, polling, and public opinion on work and costs
- [Race & Ethnicity](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/race-ethnicity): Demographic research and census data on race and ethnicity
- [Age & Generations](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/generations-age): Generational research and demographic data on aging Americans
- [Gender & LGBTQ](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/gender-lgbtq): Research on gender differences, LGBTQ issues, and social trends
- [Family & Relationships](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/family-relationships): Research data on family relationships and caregiving trends
- [Science](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/science): Science policy research and public attitudes toward scientific issues

## Engagement & Updates

- [Newsletters and Social Media](https://www.pewresearch.org/follow-us): Subscribe to Pew Research newsletters and follow on social media platforms
- [Press](https://www.pewresearch.org/press): Press contacts and journalist resources for Pew Research Center

## Support & Resources

- [Contacted By Us?](https://www.pewresearch.org/contactedbyus): FAQ for survey participants contacted by Pew Research Center
